scope: Source-verified candidate selection, not an exhaustive 2026 SOTA ranking. Original paper full texts/datasets are not all available.

entries.name: cuRoboV2-Fast
entries.paper_title: cuRoboV2-Fast: Fast Torque-Limited Collision-Free Motion Planning
entries.blocker: No CUDA device/driver in the selected environment; V2 adapter not yet validated. No CPU substitute is reported as cuRobo.
entries.source_reviewed: Official README/API/usage source inspected; paper full text not claimed read unless separately recorded

entries.name: Drake GlobalInverseKinematics
entries.paper_title: Global Inverse Kinematics via Mixed-integer Convex Optimization
scenarios: certified infeasibility and reconstructed posture checks
entries.blocker: Global MICP adapter and solver availability not validated; SciPy SLSQP is not presented as Drake Global IK.
entries.peer_review_status: IJRR 2019, identified in official API documentation
entries.source_reviewed: Official README/API/usage source inspected; paper full text not claimed read unless separately recorded

entries.name: IKFlow
entries.paper_title: IKFlow: Generating Diverse Inverse Kinematics Solutions
entries.blocker: Pretrained-model and robot-configuration adapter not validated; learned approximate solutions must pass common FK and collision validation.
entries.peer_review_status: IEEE RA-L 2022, citation verified in author repository
entries.source_reviewed: Official README/API/usage source inspected; paper full text not claimed read unless separately recorded

entries.name: TRAC-IK
entries.paper_title: TRAC-IK: An Open-Source Library for Improved Solving of Generic Inverse Kinematics
entries.blocker: Official KDL/NLopt native adapter not installed. Modern reconstructed common cases use different robots/norm tolerances and are not original-paper reproductions.
entries.peer_review_status: Humanoids 2015; original and updated protocol documented in official repository
entries.source_reviewed: Official README/API/usage source inspected; paper full text not claimed read unless separately recorded

entries.name: TrajOpt / Tesseract
entries.group: TrajOpt research line / Tesseract Robotics maintainers
entries.blocker: Trajectory adapter and full collision model not validated; static IK iteration paths are not compared as certified robot trajectories.
entries.peer_review_status: Maintained implementation inspected; bibliographic record of the original paper still requires full-text verification
entries.source_reviewed: Official README/API/usage source inspected; paper full text not claimed read unless separately recorded
